name: Dungeness
cadence: Two shipments — one on joining, one at the next Grande Cuvée disgorgement.
quantity: Five bottles across the current house releases.
statement: The house's quietest tier. A measured, considered acquaintance — enough wine to follow a single year of the house, no more, no less. For those who prefer to begin slowly.
privileges: First access to each general release before the shop opens publicly
Ten percent on any additional purchase through the year
One invitation, per calendar year, to a private winemaker tasting
logistics: Priced at $264 per allocation. Ten members per release cycle.

name: Chinook
position: A full year with the house.
cadence: Two shipments per year — on joining, and at the next Grande Cuvée disgorgement.
quantity: A case — twelve bottles — curated from across the house.
statement: The membership for those who want to keep the house on their table. Complete coverage of each vintage, preferred allocation on Ocean Aged bottlings, and a standing welcome at the winemaker's table.
privileges: Guaranteed allocation on every general release
Preferred access to Ocean Aged and library bottles
Ten percent on any additional purchase through the year
Complimentary shipping anywhere in British Columbia — or ten percent off at pickup
One invitation per shipment to a private winemaker tasting with Kaine and Sarah
logistics: Priced at $530 per allocation. Ten members per release cycle.

name: Orca
cadence: Two shipments per year, at doubled allocation.
quantity: Two cases — twenty-four bottles — across every release the house makes.
statement: The deepest relationship with the house. Every cuvée, every Ocean Aged retrieval, every library disgorgement — first look, first pour, first allocation. Reserved for the five who wish to live with every wine we make.
privileges: First right of allocation on every micro-release, doubled
First look at each Ocean Aged retrieval before the public release
A library bottle with each shipment, chosen by the winemaker
Ten percent on any additional purchase through the year
Complimentary shipping anywhere in British Columbia — or ten percent off at pickup
Two invitations per year to private tastings on the estate
logistics: Priced at $1,060 per allocation. Five members per release cycle.
